cohort: Obese pregnant women without pregestational diabetes, enrolled between 10 0/7 and 13 6/7 weeks of gestation, with a pre-pregnancy or early pregnancy BMI greater than 30 kg/m2.
finding: First trimester Quantose IR appears to be a valid measure of insulin resistance in obese pregnant women and predicts GDM diagnosed in the second trimester and neonatal hypoglycemia.
gest_age: Enrollment between 10 0/7 and 13 6/7 weeks of gestation, with measurements taken at 10 0/7 to 13 6/7 weeks (T1) and 24 0/7 to 28 0/7 weeks (T2).
